product_family: Wave (waveapps.com) - free/paid small-business accounting, invoicing, receipt scanning, payments processing, and payroll, plus a human bookkeeping/tax add-on called Wave Advisors. Toronto-based; acquired by H&R Block in 2019 and now operated as an H&R Block subsidiary.

certifications.name: PCI DSS (Level 1 Service Provider)
certifications.proof_quote: Wave is Level 1 PCI-DSS certified. This means that every year we have a third-party audit to validate our practices and make sure we're doing the right things for you and your customers.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1/2)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a SOC 2 report on Wave Financial Inc.'s own domain (waveapps.com). Wave's 'Your Security' page describes encryption and PCI-DSS but makes no SOC 2 claim, and no trust-center portal (Vanta/SafeBase/Sprinto) exists for waveapps.com. A different, unrelated company operating a meeting-transcription product also branded 'Wave' (wave.co) publishes a SOC 2 Type 1 attestation; that certification belongs to a separate corporate entity and product, not to Wave Financial Inc.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on waveapps.com. A third-party aggregator (Nudge Security) lists 'SOC 2 and ISO 27001' for 'Wave' without vendor-domain sourcing; this appears to conflate the unrelated Wave-branded products (wave.co, Wave Connect/wavecnct.com, WAAVE) rather than Wave Financial Inc.'s accounting platform.

certifications.name: GDPR (formal posture/DPA)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a Wave Financial Inc. GDPR statement or downloadable DPA. A long-running Wave community thread ('Does anyone know how Wave is dealing with GDPR?') indicates the topic has historically gone unanswered by Wave staff. A DPA found via search belongs to 'Wave Solutions Ltd' (waveapp.co.uk), a distinct UK company, not Wave Financial Inc.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence; Wave's own Security page makes no HIPAA claim and the product is general small-business accounting/invoicing, not marketed for healthcare/PHI use. A third-party HIPAA-compliance checker states Wave is not HIPAA compliant and healthcare businesses are not supported.

privacy.ai_training_note: Wave discloses use of machine learning to auto-categorize financial transactions (a product feature), but no vendor statement was found confirming or denying whether customer financial data is used to train broader AI/ML models, and no opt-out mechanism is documented in the pages reviewed.
privacy.data_region: Not publicly specified in the pages reviewed. Wave Financial Inc. is headquartered in Toronto, Canada (H&R Block subsidiary); no explicit data-residency statement was located.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: All page loads and data uploads to Wave are encrypted in transit; mobile app-to-server communications are encrypted using security protocols.

security.name: Password handling
security.value: Passwords are encrypted when collected and when sent to Wave's servers; not stored unencrypted.

security.name: Data storage / physical security
security.value: Accounting data is stored on servers with strict physical access and technical controls; facilities are monitored 24/7 with strictly controlled access.

security.name: Payment card security
security.value: PCI DSS Level 1 service provider, with annual third-party audits.

products.name: Wave Accounting
products.data_scope: Business financial transactions, bank/card connections, receipts
products.notes: Core free product; no dedicated compliance page beyond the general security statement.

products.name: Wave Payments
products.category: Payment processing (cards, bank transfer, Apple Pay)
products.notes: Scope of the PCI DSS Level 1 certification.

products.name: Wave Payroll
products.data_scope: Employee PII, SSN/SIN, bank details, wage data
products.notes: Recently integrated with payroll partner CheckHQ (privacy policy updated Jan 10, 2025 for this integration); highest-sensitivity data scope in the product family.

products.name: Wave Advisors
products.data_scope: Full financial records shared with in-house advisors
products.notes: Service layer on top of the core product, not a separate compliance surface.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium: core accounting/invoicing free; paid transaction fees on Payments, subscription pricing for Payroll, and fee-based Advisors services

flags: Several unrelated companies also use the name 'Wave': wave.co (AI meeting note-taker, SOC 2 Type 1 via Vanta), Wave Connect / wavecnct.com (digital business cards, SOC 2 Type 2 via Sprinto), WAAVE (trust.getwaave.com), Wave Solutions Ltd / waveapp.co.uk (a UK company with its own DPA), and D-Wave Quantum. None of these certifications or DPAs belong to Wave Financial Inc. (waveapps.com), the vendor covered in this report.

A third-party security-profile aggregator (Nudge Security) claims Wave is 'GDPR compliant' with 'SOC 2 and ISO 27001', but supplies no vendor-domain proof; this appears to blend the unrelated Wave-branded products described above.

No dedicated trust center or compliance portal exists on waveapps.com, unlike several sibling 'Wave'-branded products that use SafeBase/Vanta/Sprinto trust centers, increasing the risk of accidental cross-attribution.
Wave Payroll now integrates with third-party partner CheckHQ (privacy policy updated Jan 10, 2025); no independent compliance disclosure was located for this integration.
